bibl.title: Distributed coding of choice, action and engagement across the mouse brain

person.p: the tag layer; a sentence written by the tagger about the paper, always anchored to a quotation but not itself a quotation

span.label: WHERE the neurons encoding vision, choice, action and behavioral engagement sit - IT IS UNKNOWN HOW THE NEURONS MEDIATING THESE PROCESSES ARE DISTRIBUTED ACROSS BRAIN REGIONS
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: which regions carry signals that predict the CHOSEN action rather than merely accompanying movement - NEURONAL SIGNALS THAT CORRELATE WITH ACTION DO NOT NECESSARILY CORRELATE WITH ACTION SELECTION
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: NEURONS IN NEARLY ALL REGIONS RESPONDED NON-SPECIFICALLY WHEN THE MOUSE INITIATED AN ACTION, BY CONTRAST, NEURONS ENCODING VISUAL STIMULI AND UPCOMING CHOICES OCCUPIED RESTRICTED REGIONS - and CHOICE SIGNALS WERE RARE AND EMERGED WITH INDISTINGUISHABLE TIMING ACROSS REGIONS
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: existence
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: brain-wide distribution of neural coding for vision, action, choice and task engagement
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: electrophysiology
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: A recurrent loop between forebrain and midbrain choice areas keeps their choice signals simultaneous despite their different encoding schemes
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Engagement raises subcortical baseline firing toward the threshold at which movements are triggered, so the same stimulus is more likely to release an action
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Arousal-linked hyperpolarization and reduced spiking in cortex sharpens the signal-to-noise ratio of sensory representations, explaining why engagement suppresses neocortical activity
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the criterion the paper sets itself before measuring anything: TO CARRY SUCH CHOICE-RELATED SIGNALS, A BRAIN REGION MUST CONTAIN NEURONS WHOSE FIRING SELECTIVELY PREDICTS THE CHOSEN ACTION BEFORE THE ACTION OCCURS
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the design that makes the criterion testable: THE SAME VISUAL STIMULUS COULD THEREFORE LEAD TO EITHER DIRECTION OF TURN, OR TO NO ACTION, ALLOWING US TO DISSOCIATE THE NEURAL CORRELATES OF THE VISUAL STIMULI, OF ACTION INITIATION AND OF ACTION SELECTION
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the two encodings that differ without differing in time: IN MIDBRAIN NEARLY ALL CHOICE-SELECTIVE NEURONS (53/54, 98%) PREFERRED CONTRALATERAL CHOICES, while forebrain neurons COULD PREFER EITHER CHOICE, giving A DISTINCTIVE 'BILATERAL' ENCODING OF BOTH CHOICES IN THE FOREBRAIN, VERSUS A 'UNILATERAL' ENCODING OF CONTRALATERAL CHOICES IN THE MIDBRAIN
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the proposed reason engagement helps: ENHANCED ACTIVITY IN SUBCORTICAL AREAS BRINGS ACTIVITY IN THESE REGIONS CLOSER TO THE LEVEL AT WHICH ACTIONS ARE INITIATED, PROVIDING A POTENTIAL MECHANISM FOR INCREASED PROBABILITY OF ACTION IN ENGAGED STATES
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and what the global pre-movement activity cannot be: THESE SIGNALS MAY COMPRISE FORMS OF COROLLARY DISCHARGE, BUT CANNOT REFLECT SENSORY RE-AFFERENCE AS THEY WERE OBSERVED PRIOR TO MOVEMENT ONSET
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Sample sizes were not set by a power analysis.
span.note: what this limits: every effect size and null in the survey: THE SAMPLE SIZES (n = 10 MICE; n = 39 RECORDING SESSIONS; n = 29,134 NEURONS) WERE NOT DETERMINED WITH A POWER ANALYSIS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Whether visual responses in the newly implicated 'motor' choice areas would exist in untrained animals cannot be determined from these data.
span.note: what this limits: the same scope as item 7 - whether visual responses in the newly implicated motor choice areas would exist in untrained animals cannot be determined here
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Circuit mechanisms, omitted regions (cerebellum, brainstem) and generality to other choice tasks all remain for future work.
span.note: what this limits: the mechanistic and anatomical completeness of the survey: FUTURE WORK WILL BE REQUIRED TO DETERMINE THE CIRCUIT MECHANISMS THAT ENFORCE THESE PRINCIPLES
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The experimenter was not blinded to the stimulus contrast condition during acquisition or analysis.
span.note: what this limits: the contrast-condition comparisons: THE EXPERIMENTER WAS NOT BLINDED TO CONTRAST CONDITION EITHER DURING DATA ACQUISITION OR DURING ANALYSIS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Six of 39 sessions had to be dropped from the choice-probability control analysis for too few usable trials.
span.note: what this limits: the choice-probability control analysis: SIX SESSIONS HAD TO BE EXCLUDED FOR HAVING FEWER THAN 10 TRIALS INCLUDE-ABLE IN THE CP ANALYSIS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE FRACTION OF CROSS-VALIDATED VARIANCE THE KERNELS EXPLAINED WAS FREQUENTLY SMALL, EVEN FOR NEURONS WHOSE MEAN RATES THEY ACCURATELY PREDICTED (50.2% for one and 13.6% for another)
span.note: what this limits: reading `this neuron encodes action` as a statement about that neuron's spiking rather than about its trial-averaged rate
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a quarter of the neurons could not be placed - WE RECORDED FROM 29,134 NEURONS, OF WHICH 22,458 WERE LOCALIZABLE TO ONE OF 42 BRAIN REGIONS
span.note: what this limits: any per-region count or map: WE RECORDED FROM 29,134 NEURONS ... OF WHICH 22,458 WERE LOCALIZABLE TO ONE OF 42 BRAIN REGIONS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the training may have made the finding - WHETHER VISUAL NEURONS WOULD BE FOUND these ‘MOTOR’ AREAS IN UNTRAINED ANIMALS IS NOT CLEAR FROM THESE DATA
span.note: what this limits: reading the visual responses in midbrain and striatum as a property of those structures rather than of trained animals
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the survey is not the brain - future work must determine HOW THEY EXTEND TO AREAS SUCH AS CEREBELLUM AND BRAINSTEM OMITTED FROM THE CURRENT SURVEY, and THE EXTENT TO WHICH SIMILAR PRINCIPLES GOVERN THE NEURAL CORRELATES OF DIFFERENT CHOICE TASKS
span.note: what this limits: the brain-wide reading of the survey: future work must determine HOW THEY EXTEND TO AREAS SUCH AS CEREBELLUM AND BRAINSTEM OMITTED FROM THE CURRENT SURVEY
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the timing result is a null - WE COULD NOT DISTINGUISH THE TIMING OF CHOICE-RELATED SIGNALS BETWEEN THESE REGIONS, and the recurrent loop is offered as the PARSIMONIOUS explanation of that null rather than as a measurement
span.note: what this limits: reading the recurrent loop as observed rather than as the simplest account of an absence
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: JOINT PERI-EVENT CANONICAL CORRELATION (jPECC) ANALYSIS, A NOVEL EXTENSION OF THE “JOINT PERISTIMULUS TIME HISTOGRAM” METHOD MODIFIED TO DETECT CORRELATIONS IN A “COMMUNICATION SUBSPACE” BETWEEN TWO POPULATIONS
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a version of CHOICE PROBABILITY ANALYSIS FOR TASKS WITH MANY STIMULUS CONDITIONS, CALLED COMBINED-CONDITIONS CHOICE PROBABILITY, which QUANTIFIES THE PROBABILITY THAT A NEURON'S SPIKE COUNT WILL BE GREATER ON TRIALS WITH ONE CHOICE THAN TRIALS OF ANOTHER, FOR MATCHED STIMULUS CONDITIONS
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the visual contrast matched between the conditions being compared
span.note: eliminates: the activity difference reflecting different visual drive - CONTRALATERAL VISUAL STIMULUS CONTRASTS WERE MATCHED so that DIFFERENCES IN ACTIVITY DO NOT REFLECT DIFFERING VISUAL DRIVE
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the task-context comparison restricted to trials where the animal did nothing, against passive presentation
span.note: eliminates: movement explaining the context difference - BOTH VISUAL STIMULI AND BEHAVIORAL REPORTS WERE IDENTICAL, and the conditions were MATCHED FOR VISUAL STIMULATION AND (LACK OF) ACTION
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the engagement index computed from PRE-STIMULUS activity only
span.note: eliminates: the index being a movement correlate - WE EXAMINED ONLY PRE-STIMULUS ACTIVITY, WHICH COULD NOT BE CONFLATED WITH THE LARGE NON-SPECIFIC RESPONSES RELATED TO MOVEMENTS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the engagement effect tested against pupil diameter, video-detectable movement, previous reward and inter-trial interval
span.note: eliminates: arousal, movement, reward history and timing - the effect COULD NOT BE FULLY EXPLAINED BY VARIABILITY IN PUPIL DIAMETER, IN OVERT MOVEMENTS DETECTABLE BY VIDEO RECORDINGS, IN THE PRESENCE OF A REWARD ON THE PREVIOUS TRIAL, OR IN THE INTER-TRIAL INTERVAL
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the kernel test's threshold set from shuffled data
span.note: eliminates: the encoding counts being a product of the test - WE USED PARAMETERS WHICH GAVE FALSE-POSITIVE ERROR RATES OF 0.33% ON SHUFFLED DATA
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the whole choice result repeated with a second, independent statistic
span.note: eliminates: the conclusion depending on the kernel model - a version of CHOICE PROBABILITY ANALYSIS FOR TASKS WITH MANY STIMULUS CONDITIONS was developed and EMPLOYING THIS METHOD, WE OBTAINED SIMILAR RESULTS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the analysis restricted to activity before the movement
span.note: eliminates: activity caused by the movement being read as predicting it - AS OUR QUESTION CONCERNS ACTIVITY PREDICTIVE OF UPCOMING MOVEMENTS, WE APPLIED THIS ANALYSIS ONLY TO PRE-MOVEMENT ACTIVITY
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A CRITERION FOR WHAT COUNTS AS EVIDENCE, STATED BEFORE ANYTHING IS MEASURED: NEURONAL SIGNALS THAT CORRELATE WITH ACTION DO NOT NECESSARILY CORRELATE WITH ACTION SELECTION - TO CARRY SUCH CHOICE-RELATED SIGNALS, A BRAIN REGION MUST CONTAIN NEURONS WHOSE FIRING SELECTIVELY PREDICTS THE CHOSEN ACTION BEFORE THE ACTION OCCURS
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND A WHOLE CLASS OF DESIGNS CANNOT MEET IT: GO/NOGO TASKS CANNOT DISTINGUISH NEURONS THAT NONSPECIFICALLY FIRE FOR ANY ACTION, FROM NEURONS SELECTIVE FOR SPECIFIC CHOICES. Not a result being corrected - a design being retired, and every finding that used it inherits the ambiguity
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE SAME STIMULUS AND THE SAME behavior, DIFFERENT ACTIVITY: BOTH VISUAL STIMULI AND BEHAVIORAL REPORTS WERE IDENTICAL, and EVEN THOUGH THE TWO CONDITIONS WERE MATCHED FOR VISUAL STIMULATION AND (LACK OF) ACTION, THEY WERE ACCOMPANIED IN MANY AREAS BY DIFFERENT ACTIVITY, BOTH BEFORE AND AFTER STIMULUS PRESENTATION. The response is not a property of the stimulus
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the context effect has OPPOSITE SIGNS in different structures: ACTIVITY IN VISp WAS LOWER IN THE TASK THAN IN THE PASSIVE TRIALS, WHEREAS ACTIVITY IN CP SHOWED THE OPPOSITE MODULATION - WHILE NEOCORTEX AND SENSORY THALAMUS SHOWED A NET DECREASE, OTHER REGIONS SHOWED A CONSISTENT INCREASE. A brain-wide average of this is zero
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE GLOBAL SIGNAL IS ABOUT MOVING, NOT ABOUT THE TASK: THE WIDELY DISTRIBUTED ACTIVITY SEEN FOLLOWING TRIAL ONSET WAS THEREFORE PRESENT ONLY WHEN ANIMALS MOVED, AND REGARDLESS OF THE PARTICULAR STIMULUS AND PARTICULAR ACTION
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the ordering of areas reverses with the side of the stimulus: WHEN THE MOUSE SUCCESSFULLY SELECTED AN IPSILATERAL STIMULUS, MOST AREAS WERE AGAIN ACTIVATED, BUT VIS AND SCs WERE NOW AMONGST THE LAST AREAS TO RESPOND, RATHER THAN THE FIRST
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: WHAT IS GLOBAL AND WHAT IS NOT, MEASURED RATHER THAN ASSERTED: NEURONS ENCODING ACTION WERE SPREAD THROUGHOUT ALL RECORDED REGIONS, and THE GREAT MAJORITY OF NEURONS ENCODING ACTION DID NOT REQUIRE AN ADDITIONAL CHOICE KERNEL - THEY RESPONDED EQUALLY FOR MOVEMENTS IN EITHER DIRECTION
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the negative that makes the positive mean something: CHOICE-SELECTIVE NEURONS WERE NOT FOUND IN VISp, although THIS SET OF REGIONS ENCODING CHOICE OVERLAPPED PARTIALLY WITH THE VISUAL PATHWAY
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE SAME VARIABLE ENCODED IN TWO INCOMPATIBLE WAYS IN TWO PLACES: IN MIDBRAIN NEARLY ALL CHOICE-SELECTIVE NEURONS (53/54, 98%) PREFERRED CONTRALATERAL CHOICES, whereas in forebrain A SIZEABLE PROPORTION PREFERRED IPSILATERAL CHOICES (19/48, 40%). A `midbrain encodes choice` tag and a `forebrain encodes choice` tag are the same words for opposite arrangements
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A NULL DOING THE ARGUMENTATIVE WORK: WE COULD NOT DISTINGUISH THE TIMING OF CHOICE-RELATED SIGNALS BETWEEN THESE REGIONS, AN OBSERVATION PARSIMONIOUSLY EXPLAINED BY A RECURRENT LOOP ACROSS THEM - the loop is the simplest account of an absence, and is labeled as such
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the null was sought two ways: the decoding time course COULD NOT BE STATISTICALLY DISTINGUISHED BETWEEN CHOICE-SELECTIVE REGIONS, and jPECC REVEALED NO LAG FOR ACTIVITY CORRELATIONS BETWEEN FRONTAL AND MIDBRAIN AREAS while it DID reveal A CONSISTENT TIME-LAG between visual and frontal cortex
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE MODEL EXPLAINS LITTLE OF WHAT IT PREDICTS WELL: THE FRACTION OF CROSS-VALIDATED VARIANCE THE KERNELS EXPLAINED WAS FREQUENTLY SMALL, EVEN FOR NEURONS WHOSE MEAN RATES THEY ACCURATELY PREDICTED - 50.2% for one example neuron and 13.6% for another
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE ERROR RATE OF THE CLASSIFICATION IS PRINTED: WE USED PARAMETERS WHICH GAVE FALSE-POSITIVE ERROR RATES OF 0.33% ON SHUFFLED DATA - so every count of encoding neurons in this paper has a stated denominator of error
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AN INDEX DEFINED BY THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN TWO CONTEXTS, AND CHECKED AGAINST FOUR CONFOUNDS: the engagement index COULD NOT BE FULLY EXPLAINED BY VARIABILITY IN PUPIL DIAMETER, IN OVERT MOVEMENTS DETECTABLE BY VIDEO RECORDINGS, IN THE PRESENCE OF A REWARD ON THE PREVIOUS TRIAL, OR IN THE INTER-TRIAL INTERVAL
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: ENGAGEMENT MOVES CORTEX AND SUBCORTEX IN OPPOSITE DIRECTIONS: CORRELATES OF ENGAGEMENT ARE CHARACTERIZED BY ENHANCED SUBCORTICAL ACTIVITY AND SUPPRESSED NEOCORTICAL ACTIVITY PRIOR TO VISUAL STIMULUS ONSET - and the authors flag it, ENGAGEMENT-RELATED CORTICAL SUPPRESSION MIGHT SEEM SURPRISING, GIVEN THAT VISUAL CORTEX IS REQUIRED FOR PERFORMANCE OF THIS TASK
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A QUARTER OF THE DATA HAS NO ADDRESS: WE RECORDED FROM 29,134 NEURONS, OF WHICH 22,458 WERE LOCALIZABLE TO ONE OF 42 BRAIN REGIONS - every per-region number in the paper has that denominator behind it
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and a majority are modulated, in both directions: A SIZEABLE FRACTION OF ALL NEURONS (60.0%, 13,466 NEURONS) HAD SIGNIFICANT MODULATION OF FIRING RATE DURING THE TASK - MOST OF THESE NEURONS (74.3%) CONSISTENTLY INCREASED THEIR ACTIVITY, BUT A SIZEABLE MINORITY (20.2%) CONSISTENTLY DECREASED
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: WHAT THE GLOBAL SIGNAL CANNOT BE, ON A TIMING ARGUMENT: THESE SIGNALS MAY COMPRISE FORMS OF COROLLARY DISCHARGE, BUT CANNOT REFLECT SENSORY RE-AFFERENCE AS THEY WERE OBSERVED PRIOR TO MOVEMENT ONSET
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the finding may belong to the trained animal rather than to the structure: WHETHER VISUAL NEURONS WOULD BE FOUND these ‘MOTOR’ AREAS IN UNTRAINED ANIMALS IS NOT CLEAR FROM THESE DATA
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: phenomenon: activity that appears everywhere in the brain before a movement, in regions with no established role in choosing it
span.note: a second reading DIFFERING from the recorded value. Recorded: brain-wide distribution of neural coding for vision, action, choice and task engagement — a second reading, verbatim-verified, disagreeing with the value on the record. Not applied - a person decides.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: midbrain —causes→ contralateral
span.note: depends on: which structure the neuron is in - by contrast forebrain neurons COULD PREFER EITHER CHOICE, WITH A SIZEABLE PROPORTION PREFERRING IPSILATERAL CHOICES (19/48, 40%) · strength of the relation: 0.98 — IN MIDBRAIN NEARLY ALL CHOICE-SELECTIVE NEURONS (53/54, 98%) PREFERRED CONTRALATERAL CHOICES 2026-08-20 terminal-a re-read (Q-878 worst chars/edge queue): WRONG-TYPE - `nearly all choice-selective neurons (53/54, 98%) PREFERRED contralateral choices`. A population's tuning preference is not causation - the neurons encode the choice, they do not cause the side.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: forebrain —causes→ ipsilateral
span.note: strength of the relation: 0.4 — the record marks this weak — A DISTINCTIVE 'BILATERAL' ENCODING OF BOTH CHOICES IN THE FOREBRAIN, VERSUS A 'UNILATERAL' ENCODING OF CONTRALATERAL CHOICES IN THE MIDBRAIN 2026-08-20 terminal-a re-read (Q-878 worst chars/edge queue): WRONG-TYPE - same as the midbrain edge above: forebrain neurons COULD PREFER either choice, with 40% preferring ipsilateral. An encoding preference, typed as causation.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.note: differs in: THE AXIS IS WHAT THEY SHARE AND WHAT THEY DO NOT, BOTH NAMED IN ONE CLAUSE. 'Although Quotation withheld.' Identical on timing, different on code. A bare `contrasted-with` records the difference and drops the fact that the obvious explanation - one region leading the other - is ruled out in the same sentence. Q-467. · strength of the relation: 1 — ALTHOUGH Quotation withheld - a 'BILATERAL' ENCODING OF BOTH CHOICES IN THE FOREBRAIN, VERSUS a 'UNILATERAL' ENCODING OF CONTRALATERAL CHOICES IN THE MIDBRAIN 2026-08-20 terminal-a re-read (Q-878 worst chars/edge queue): SOUND - the passage is built as this contrast and says so twice - `By contrast` and `a distinctive bilateral encoding ... in the forebrain, VERSUS a unilateral encoding ... in the midbrain`. Both endpoints named, type correct. KEEP.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
